stances.summary: Criticizes anonymous forums for breeding poor behavior and lacking quality control
stances.quote: Economics Job Market Rumors started back when I was on the job market 20 years ago. I remember how much the uncertainty of getting a job makes you seek out any kind of info. But quality matters. An anon forum was never going to cut it. And it would breed bad behavior. It did.

stances.summary: Celebrates shutdown of anonymous economics forum due to toxicity and bot attacks
stances.quote: I heard this week that the cesspool econ website EJMR went dark. it’s been offline for over a week now. no tears shed here. solid poetic justice that unrelenting AI bot attacks appear to have been its downfall. but it raises a question: where does the demand for info go next?
